description.en: Create and run conditional sequences, nested if/else branches, wait conditions, delays, HTTP requests, and cross-integration entity commands from an Unfolded Circle Remote through a simple local web interface.

value.en: Complete the integration setup, then open the local web interface on port 8099 to connect the Remote Core API and create advanced automations. Enabled automations are exposed as commands and touchscreen buttons on the Advanced Automations remote entity.
